data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this brand-new, ultra-luxury 5-bedroom corner villa, vacant and ready for immediate move-in at Address Villas Hillcrest, Dubai Hills Estate.

Experience the height of branded luxury living in Emaar’s most exclusive residential enclave. This pristine, never-lived-in corner property offers unparalleled privacy, a massive private basement, and a spectacular rooftop terrace overlooking the community, making it the perfect sanctuary for families and corporate executives seeking a premium lifestyle.

Property Highlights:

Availability: Vacant Now / Ready to Move In
Type: 5 Spacious Bedrooms + Separate Spacious Maid's Room
The Basement: Huge 2,700 Sq. Ft. multi-purpose basement with natural light (ideal for a private gym, cinema, and kids' playroom)
Rooftop Level: Private family lounge opening onto a massive terrace with panoramic views
Living Space: Expansive open-plan show kitchen for entertaining, plus a separate closed wet kitchen for daily prep
Plot Advantage: Premium corner plot offering a large private garden (provision for a pool)
Parking: 3 Secure, shaded parking bays

The Address Hillcrest Lifestyle:

Tenants enjoy full access to the ultra-premium, boutique gated community facilities:

Exclusive Resident Clubhouse & High-End Gym
Resort-Style Swimming Pool & Sun Pavilions
Landscaped Walking Trails, Linear Park, and BBQ Areas
24/7 Premium Gated Security & Concierge Feel

Unmatched Proximity for Families:

02 Mins: Dubai Hills Mall (Shopping, Dining & Entertainment)
04 Mins: King’s College Hospital (World-class healthcare)
07-08 Mins: Elite Schools (Safa Community School & King’s School Dubai Hills)
10 Mins: Mall of the Emirates
20 Mins: Dubai International Airport

For further details, or to schedule a private viewing, please contact me today.
